svg.title: 32 paths rotating through every direction
svg.desc: A script-free animation rotating 32 differently coloured projected Euler residual routes, arranged as 16 pairs symmetric about the centre.
svg.text: One traced route, copied through 32 evenly spaced directions; opposite colours form exact centre-symmetric pairs.

g.text: • all routes begin and end at cancellation

svg.text: The coloured copies change only the 2D viewing direction. Pair k+16 is a 180° rotation of pair k, so the two traces remain symmetric about the white centre at every instant.
